title: Multiple accounts in the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex
excerpt: Every ChatGPT account in its own copy of the ChatGPT desktop app, side by side, on Mac and Windows.
content_html:
Sessions Pro for Codex
How it works What's kept Usage Codex CLI Windows Pricing FAQ

macOS Windows

For ChatGPT and Codex on Mac and Windows

Run your work, personal and client accounts side by side in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac and Windows, each in its own app. Every account keeps its own login, Codex history, projects and pins.

  1. 1Install
  2. 2Import your current ChatGPT
  3. 3Create your Work profile
  • Free 1-hour preview
  • One-time purchasePay once, 2 computers
  • macOS 14+ · Windows 10/11

Every account, its own app.

Each profile is a real Mac app with its own Dock icon and colored letter badge, so you always know which ChatGPT you're talking to.

  • Switch with ⌘-Tab
  • Menu bar account switcher
  • Own Dock icon per account
  • Own login per account
  • Codex CLI per account
  • Threads, projects & pins kept
  • Updates with ChatGPT
  • Brings your current ChatGPT along
  • codex:// links go to the right app
  • Apple silicon & Intel
  • Runs the official ChatGPT app
  • 1-hour free preview

What it is
An app for Mac and Windows that runs several ChatGPT and Codex accounts at the same time, each as its own app.

Price
$15 one-time, lifetime license for up to 2 computers, Mac or PC; add 3 more for $9.99. 14-day full refund.

Works with
OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app (with Codex) on macOS 14 Sonoma or later (Apple silicon and Intel), or from the Microsoft Store on Windows 10 and 11 (x64 and Arm).

Kept per account
Login, conversations, Codex threads, projects and pins, plus its own Codex CLI.

Updates
Installs each new ChatGPT desktop app version from OpenAI for you (checked for OpenAI’s signature first) and brings every profile up to date. Sessions Pro for Codex updates itself too.

Every detail stays with its account.

Nothing gets mixed up between accounts, and nothing gets lost when you add one.

Logins

Each profile stays signed in to its own account. Signing in to one never signs you out of another.

Codex history

Each account's conversations and Codex threads open in its own window, ready to pick up where you left off.

Projects

Work projects stay in the work profile, side projects in yours, each with its own list.

Pins

Pinned threads and projects stay pinned in the right account.

codex:// links

On a Mac, connector sign-ins and thread links go to the profile you used last.

Its own app

A colored letter badge on the Dock icon, its own place in ⌘-Tab and Spotlight, and its own window.

Already using ChatGPT? Choose “Start from my current ChatGPT” and your conversations, Codex threads, projects, pins and login are copied into a profile. Your original ChatGPT app is left unchanged.

Up and running in 1 minute.

  1. InstallDownload Sessions Pro for Codex for Mac or Windows and install it. It finds the ChatGPT app on your computer.

  2. Import your current ChatGPTChoose “Start from my current ChatGPT”. Your conversations, Codex threads, projects, pins and login are copied into a profile, for example “Codex Personal”. The original stays as it is.

  3. Create your Work profileClick +, name it Work and sign in with your work account. “Codex Work” and “Codex Personal” now run side by side; switch with ⌘-Tab or the menu bar.

A ChatGPT account switcher in your menu bar.

The colored letter in the menu bar shows which account is in front. Click it to switch between ChatGPT accounts in one step, or to open one that isn’t running.

  • Open all your accounts at once
  • See which ones are running
  • Create a new profile from anywhere

Every account’s Codex usage, at a glance.

See how much of each ChatGPT account’s Codex session and weekly limit is used, and when each resets, without opening every account. It sits in the menu bar on a Mac and the tray on Windows.

  • Session and weekly usage for every account, side by side
  • An alert at 80% and 95%, before an account runs out
  • Read from each profile’s own ChatGPT sign-in, and sent only to ChatGPT

After your free hour, Sessions Pro for Codex keeps showing one account’s usage for free. A license shows every account. How it works

Multiple Codex CLI accounts, too.

Each profile comes with its own Codex CLI. It runs with that profile's own CODEX_HOME, so codex in Terminal is signed in to the same ChatGPT account as the profile's app.

In the app

Each account's Codex threads, projects and pins stay in its own profile. Pick them up exactly where you left off.

In Terminal

“Open Codex CLI in Terminal” runs the profile's built-in codex with its own CODEX_HOME, so the CLI is signed in to the right account too.

Your usage, per account

Work runs on your work plan, side projects on yours. No more signing out and back in between tasks.

Why not a script or a second user?

You can juggle accounts with Terminal scripts or by switching macOS users. Here's what you give up. See every method compared, with the free Terminal and CODEX_HOME setups →

Own Dock icon and ⌘-Tab entry✓Usually not✕✕
Codex threads, projects and pins kept per account✓Manual✓✕
Codex CLI signed in per account✓Manual✓✕
Keeps up with ChatGPT updates✓Updater runs in every copy✓✓
No Terminal needed✓✕✓✓

Now on Windows too.

The same idea, built for Windows. Each account runs as its own copy of the ChatGPT app, in a window titled with its profile name, so you always know which one you're typing into.

  • Each account in its own window, titled “ChatGPT — Work”
  • Own login, chats, Codex threads and projects per account
  • Codex command line per profile, opened in Terminal from the app
  • Open profiles from the app's window or its tray icon
  • Brings your current ChatGPT into a profile; the original stays unchanged
  • Signs in through a private browser window, so it always asks which account

For Windows 10 or 11 (x64 or Arm) with OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app (with Codex). One license covers Mac and Windows. What's different on Windows

Prefer the Microsoft Store? Get it from the Microsoft Store instead.

One price. Lifetime license.

Pay once, no subscription. Not for you? Full refund within 14 days.

$15one-time

  • Unlimited ChatGPT accounts
  • Use it on up to 2 computers, Mac or PC, move it anytime
  • Codex threads, projects and pins kept per account
  • ChatGPT and every profile kept up to date automatically
  • Menu bar or tray switcher, Codex CLI per profile

Try it free for 1 hour first: the preview starts once you've signed in to a profile.

Questions, answered.

Can I really use two ChatGPT accounts at the same time?

Yes. Each profile is its own copy of OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app with its own data, so you can keep your work and personal ChatGPT accounts, plus any client accounts, open side by side and switch with ⌘-Tab. Signing in to one never signs you out of another.

Does the ChatGPT desktop app support multiple accounts?

Not by itself. The ChatGPT app for Mac, which includes Codex, is signed in to one account at a time, so changing accounts means signing out and back in. Sessions Pro for Codex runs a separate copy of the app for each account, all signed in at once.

Do my Codex threads, projects and pins stay with each account?

Yes. Every profile keeps its own login, conversations, Codex threads, projects and pins, so nothing gets mixed up between accounts.

Can I keep what's already in my ChatGPT app?

Yes. Choose “Start from my current ChatGPT” when you create a profile. Your conversations, Codex threads, projects, pins and login are copied into that profile. Your original ChatGPT app is left unchanged.

Does it work with the Codex CLI?

Yes. Each profile has its own Codex CLI. “Open Codex CLI in Terminal” runs that profile's built-in codex with its own CODEX_HOME, so the command line is signed in to the same account as the app.

Where do codex:// links open?

On a Mac, in the profile you used last. Links such as connector sign-ins and thread links go to the most recent profile, so bring the right one to the front first. On Windows, codex:// links open your normal ChatGPT, not a profile.

Will macOS ask for permissions?

Once per profile. The first time a profile opens, macOS may ask for things like folder access and the keychain. Choose Always Allow, and it won't ask again when the profile is updated.

Can I see how much of my Codex usage limit is left?

Yes. Sessions Pro for Codex shows each ChatGPT account’s Codex session (5-hour) and weekly usage, and when each resets, in the menu bar on a Mac and the tray on Windows, and alerts you at 80% and 95%. It reads the numbers from each profile’s own ChatGPT sign-in, never changes it, and sends it only to ChatGPT. It’s checked every minute while the menu or window is open, every 5 minutes otherwise. More about Codex usage.

Is it allowed to use multiple ChatGPT accounts?

Sessions Pro for Codex runs the official ChatGPT app, signed in to accounts you have, such as your work and personal accounts. It doesn't change how ChatGPT or Codex work. OpenAI's terms still apply to each account; using several accounts to get around usage limits may break them, so use it for accounts you're allowed to have.

What happens when ChatGPT updates?

Sessions Pro for Codex keeps ChatGPT up to date for you. On a Mac, it downloads each new ChatGPT desktop app version from OpenAI, checks that it's signed by OpenAI and notarized by Apple, and installs it; if the original ChatGPT app is open, one click quits it, updates it and reopens it. Every profile app is then rebuilt from the new version the next time that profile is closed, or right away with Restart to Update. On Windows, profiles run your installed ChatGPT app directly, so they're always on its latest version. Your logins and history are kept.

Can I try it before buying?

Yes. Each computer gets a free 1-hour preview, which starts once you've signed in to a profile. After that, profiles need a license.

What if it isn’t for me?

Email us within 14 days of buying and we’ll refund you in full, no questions asked.

How many computers can I use it on?

One license works on up to 2 computers, Mac or PC in any mix. Need more? Add 3 more for $9.99 one-time, from the app when you reach the limit or at multiplecodex.com/add-computers, as often as you need. To move a license, deactivate it on the old computer, or from the app when it says the license is in use on all its computers.

Does Sessions Pro for Codex see my chats?

No. Your conversations and logins stay between your computer and OpenAI. Sessions Pro for Codex contacts its own server only to check your license and for its own updates, using your license key and an anonymous ID for your computer. It downloads new ChatGPT versions from OpenAI’s download server, and the usage meter asks ChatGPT for each account’s Codex usage with that profile’s own sign-in.

Is there a Windows version?

Yes. Sessions Pro for Codex for Windows runs on Windows 10 or 11 (x64 or Arm) with OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app (with Codex) from the Microsoft Store. Each account runs as its own copy of the ChatGPT app, side by side, with its own login, chats, Codex threads, projects and Codex command line. Each window is titled with its profile name, for example “ChatGPT — Work”, and you open profiles from the app's window or its tray icon. One license covers Mac and Windows.

What's different on Windows?

A few things work differently. codex:// links and the ChatGPT tile in the Start menu open your normal ChatGPT, not a profile. The first time you use Codex in a profile, ChatGPT asks to finish its Windows setup: one click per profile. The ChatGPT extension for Chrome connects to the profile you opened last. Profiles sign in one at a time, each through a private browser window (Edge, Chrome, Firefox or Brave), so it always asks which account to use.

What do I need?

A Mac with macOS 14 Sonoma or later (Apple silicon or Intel) and OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app for Mac, which includes Codex. Or a PC with Windows 10 or 11 (x64 or Arm) and OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app (with Codex) from the Microsoft Store.

Where can I get it?

Download it from multiplecodex.com for Mac (macOS 14 or later) or Windows (10 or 11), try it free for 1 hour once you've signed in to a profile, then buy a license for $15 one-time. One license covers 2 computers, Mac or PC. The Windows version is also on the Microsoft Store. More on the Sessions Pro for Codex page.

blocks.html_en: Sessions Pro for Codex keeps ChatGPT up to date for you. On a Mac, it downloads each new ChatGPT desktop app version from OpenAI, checks that it's signed by OpenAI and notarized by Apple, and installs it; if the original ChatGPT app is open, one click quits it, updates it and reopens it. Every profile app is then rebuilt from the new version the next time that profile is closed, or right away with Restart to Update. On Windows, profiles run your installed ChatGPT app directly, so they're always on its latest version. Your logins and history are kept.

Sessions Pro for Codex
How it works What's kept Usage Codex CLI Windows Pricing FAQ

macOS Windows

For ChatGPT and Codex on Mac and Windows

Run your work, personal and client accounts side by side in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac and Windows, each in its own app. Every account keeps its own login, Codex history, projects and pins.

  1. 1Install
  2. 2Import your current ChatGPT
  3. 3Create your Work profile
  • Free 1-hour preview
  • One-time purchasePay once, 2 computers
  • macOS 14+ · Windows 10/11

Every account, its own app.

Each profile is a real Mac app with its own Dock icon and colored letter badge, so you always know which ChatGPT you're talking to.

  • Switch with ⌘-Tab
  • Menu bar account switcher
  • Own Dock icon per account
  • Own login per account
  • Codex CLI per account
  • Threads, projects & pins kept
  • Updates with ChatGPT
  • Brings your current ChatGPT along
  • codex:// links go to the right app
  • Apple silicon & Intel
  • Runs the official ChatGPT app
  • 1-hour free preview

What it isAn app for Mac and Windows that runs several ChatGPT and Codex accounts at the same time, each as its own app.

Price$15 one-time, lifetime license for up to 2 computers, Mac or PC; add 3 more for $9.99. 14-day full refund.

Works withOpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app (with Codex) on macOS 14 Sonoma or later (Apple silicon and Intel), or from the Microsoft Store on Windows 10 and 11 (x64 and Arm).

Kept per accountLogin, conversations, Codex threads, projects and pins, plus its own Codex CLI.

UpdatesInstalls each new ChatGPT desktop app version from OpenAI for you (checked for OpenAI’s signature first) and brings every profile up to date. Sessions Pro for Codex updates itself too.

Every detail stays with its account.

Nothing gets mixed up between accounts, and nothing gets lost when you add one.

Logins

Each profile stays signed in to its own account. Signing in to one never signs you out of another.

Codex history

Each account's conversations and Codex threads open in its own window, ready to pick up where you left off.

项目

Work projects stay in the work profile, side projects in yours, each with its own list.

Pins

Pinned threads and projects stay pinned in the right account.

codex:// links

On a Mac, connector sign-ins and thread links go to the profile you used last.

Its own app

A colored letter badge on the Dock icon, its own place in ⌘-Tab and Spotlight, and its own window.

Already using ChatGPT? Choose “Start from my current ChatGPT” and your conversations, Codex threads, projects, pins and login are copied into a profile. Your original ChatGPT app is left unchanged.

Up and running in 1 minute.

  1. InstallDownload Sessions Pro for Codex for Mac or Windows and install it. It finds the ChatGPT app on your computer.
  2. Import your current ChatGPTChoose “Start from my current ChatGPT”. Your conversations, Codex threads, projects, pins and login are copied into a profile, for example “Codex Personal”. The original stays as it is.
  3. Create your Work profileClick +, name it Work and sign in with your work account. “Codex Work” and “Codex Personal” now run side by side; switch with ⌘-Tab or the menu bar.

A ChatGPT account switcher in your menu bar.

The colored letter in the menu bar shows which account is in front. Click it to switch between ChatGPT accounts in one step, or to open one that isn’t running.

  • Open all your accounts at once
  • See which ones are running
  • Create a new profile from anywhere

Every account’s Codex usage, at a glance.

See how much of each ChatGPT account’s Codex session and weekly limit is used, and when each resets, without opening every account. It sits in the menu bar on a Mac and the tray on Windows.

  • Session and weekly usage for every account, side by side
  • An alert at 80% and 95%, before an account runs out
  • Read from each profile’s own ChatGPT sign-in, and sent only to ChatGPT
